title: AnyCancellable Lifetimes
hints: A subscription dies when its `AnyCancellable` is deallocated.
`_ = subject.sink { … }` is cancelled right away; `.store(in: &kept)` keeps it alive.
`cancel` should cancel everything in the set and empty it.
jsBridge: A subscription lives only as long as its `AnyCancellable`. Drop it and the subscription is cancelled. RxJS makes you call `unsubscribe()`, while Combine ties it to ARC ownership.

compass.q: RxJS leaks if you forget `unsubscribe()`. What's the opposite Combine bug (it stops immediately because you didn't store the cancellable)?
Does cancelling stop upstream work (a network request) or just delivery?
`Set<AnyCancellable>` on the owner vs `.store(in:)` vs `assign(to: &$prop)`: which avoids retain cycles?
A view model's `sink { self.x = $0 }` stored in its own `cancellables`: cycle? How to fix?
